item.title: Atari: Necromancy as a business model
item.description: Atari is releasing all the old Atari 2600 Activision games – $1000 for all, $35 for one. But it’s worse than it sounds.

item.title: The Resurrection of the Atari 2600
item.description: No, this isn’t about the previous resurrection of the Atari 2600. Nor the previous one. Not that other one either. This is new.
